GitHub compare endpoint caps files at 300; full local Git data is used below.

summary.snapshot_note: Remote fetched later includes an additional audit-only branch; it is outside the frozen318-head inventory.

runtime_filter_note: Broad path/extension heuristic for inventory only. Counts include deferred packages and tooling; they are not counts of semantically reviewed core files.
scope_selection_rationale: Latest current beta consolidation plus current privacy UI and subsequent focused runtime fixes. Main provides baseline. Clipboard alternative is supplemental. Earlier variants that differ bytewise are recorded without labeling them semantically superseded. Historical/future source is not automatically added to current core audit.
